origin: The keycap is the trenchscope trace (Recraft vectorize via media-studio `media vectorize`, 2026-10-19, of the owner's keycap render, reduced to the two site colours #0a0a0a and #ededed; texture specks inside the face dropped). On 2026-11-03 the pixel t was replaced by a hand-drawn pixel s: one stepped polygon on the t's x-height with the t's stroke weights (verticals 200, bars 164) and 28-unit steps. The 16 and 32 px favicons are hand-drawn pixel versions because the halftone blurs to grey at that size. The PNG icons are rendered from these SVGs: the mark at 80.6% on #0a0a0a for icon-192, icon-512 and apple-touch-icon, 62.5% for the maskable icon.
